#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <regex>

int main() {
    std::string str;
    std::getline(std::cin, str);
    
    int os = 0;
    if (!str.empty()) {
        std::regex re("(?s)(?<=(.))(?!\\1)");
        std::sregex_token_iterator it(str.begin(), str.end(), re, -1);
        std::sregex_token_iterator end;
        std::vector<std::string> runs(it, end);
        
        // The regex splitting might produce empty strings at start/end
        // We filter them out to match Java's split behavior
        for (const auto& run : runs) {
            if (!run.empty() && run.length() % 2 == 0) {
                os++;
            }
        }
    }
    
    std::cout << os << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
